name: British Honduras
alt: Settlement in the Bay of Honduras

predecessors.name: Spanish Empire
predecessors.text: 'where the Baymen could log between the Hondo and Belize rivers' (Treaty of Versailles, 1783)

successors.name: Belize
successors.text: 'independence came to Belize on 21 September 1981, without an agreement with Guatemala'

ledger.x: 25 November 1783: the Treaty of Versailles recognises the British settlement in the Bay of Honduras.
1786: the Convention of London extends the settlement to the Sibun.
1859: the Wyke-Aycinena Treaty fixes the southern boundary at the Sarstoon.
12 May 1862: the Settlement of Belize becomes the colony of British Honduras.
1971: the capital moves from Belize City to Belmopan.
1 June 1973: British Honduras is renamed Belize.

wars.name: Belizean–Guatemalan territorial dispute
wars.outcome: A diplomatic dispute with no fighting: Guatemala recognised British sovereignty in 1859 but later claimed the south; its 1999 claim 'amounts to 12,272 km2 ... or roughly 53% of Belizean territory'.

certainty.note: The settlement's limits are rivers (Hondo, Belize, Sibun), not surveyed lines; the Spanish crown never ceded sovereignty on the pages opened.
The Sarstoon boundary of the 1859 treaty is a treaty line, but Guatemala disputed it throughout; the western frontier is not described on the pages opened.
